preconditions.description: The input x must be a number or a string.

postconditions.expression: (isinstance(x, (int, float)) and x**2 > 1000) or (isinstance(x, str) and float(x)**2 > 1000)
postconditions.description: If x squared is more than 1000, return 'It's hotter than the sun!!'.

postconditions.expression: (isinstance(x, (int, float)) and x**2 <= 1000) or (isinstance(x, str) and float(x)**2 <= 1000)
postconditions.description: If x squared is not more than 1000, return 'Help yourself to a honeycomb Yorkie for the glovebox.'.
